method: Workflow audit-run-journal (run wf_02909a46-07c): 6 finders (writers, readers, contract, legacy, tests, skill-calls+notes), 1 skeptic per finding told to refute and read git history, 1 completeness critic; 42 agents

findings.title: Writers emit raw U+2028/U+2029/U+0085 and lone surrogates (ensure_ascii=False), so the trace reader drops those rows and a surrogate drops the whole event
record_packet keeps sent copies after the trace has hit its 32 MB cap, so packets/sent grows with files no trace line names
Trace docs name the retired `chain` verb and omit the session-end hook rows the writer emits
The E2E trace reader counts a callback held for an owner note as a refusal, against the owner decision and shiploop_trace.refused
run_trace.checks packet_copies hashes a newline-translated read, so a packet holding CR fails falsely
shiploop_trace._read_jsonl splits on str.splitlines(), which drops any line holding U+2028/U+2029/U+0085 (the defect d56904e2 fixed in read_records)
Four more hand-rolled readers of trace.jsonl / skill-calls.jsonl duplicate shiploop_trace._read_jsonl with the same splitlines split
findings.outcome: fixed (shared reader; status_card keeps its own loop, split at \n)

findings.title: For a pre-`check` trace, run_trace.summary drops failed `complete --check-only` lines from both refusals and checks_failed, while `shiploop trace` counts them as refusals
Product trace reader counts pre-8bf10c64 failed `complete --check-only` lines as refusals, while the harness readers of the same file count them as checks
findings.outcome: not taken: product reads the verb only by owner decision D1 (docs/shiploop-check-phases-bc-plan-2026-10-28.md); documented

findings.title: No field contract for trace.jsonl lines: most written fields are undocumented, and the docs leave out session-end hook rows
Neither `v: 1` nor SCHEMA "shiploop-trace/v1" is read or documented, and the line format changed twice without a bump
findings.outcome: documented (v stays 1; readers key on kind)

findings.title: trace.jsonl contract still lists the removed `chain` verb
UNTRACED never decides anything: every member is already excluded because no run root is set
The documented reason lint and red-check go untraced is wrong: both write run state, and `lint --fix` edits files
The trace reader splits JSONL on Unicode line separators, so a line whose text holds U+2028/U+2029/U+0085 is silently dropped
skill-calls.jsonl's gate-line shape is undocumented; its discriminator (the presence of `gate`) is implicit

run_trace.summary and flow.trace_block take checks_failed from the product reader, which stopped counting old `complete --check-only` failures in 8bf10c64, so re-reading a run from before phase B gives a record that does not add up and does not match its own saved metrics.json

The 'run saved before the trace existed' framing is stale: the accepted-event fallback (`legacy`/`untraced_steps`) is live for harness-seeded slice steps, and only the no-trace.jsonl branch is pure legacy, which nothing in the repo reads through this reader
state-files.md and status-display.md still describe `hook` trace rows as stop decisions only; the session-end row added by 1f0bc835 is documented only in keepalive.md
Unused imports in shiploop_trace.py: datetime.timezone and typing.Iterable
The trace reader splits lines with str.splitlines, so a row holding U+2028/U+2029/U+0085 is silently dropped; d56904e2 fixed this only in skill_calls, and no test covers the trace side
No test covers how trace.build merges skill-calls.jsonl (call rows and gate rows)
No test asserts the trace rows written at an Improve stage (packet stage 'improve' with 'reviewed', command stage pair), which harness readers depend on
Nothing tests run_trace.read on the old `complete --check-only` rows it deliberately keeps reading (1,918 real rows)
No test checks that the harness treats a trace at its size cap as not covering the run
findings.outcome: open: covered by test_the_trace_stops_growing_at_its_cap for the product; harness covers() not pinned

findings.title: No test checks the TEXT_LIMIT clip and its marker on refusal or hook text
The trace counts the Improve gate's 'not enforced' line as a Skill call, so the digest and page report calls that were never made
The trace reader splits JSONL with str.splitlines(), so it drops a Skill call or trace event that contains U+2028/U+2029/U+0085 (the same defect d56904e2 fixed in the gate's reader)
When `shiploop check` prints a waiting owner note, mark_held records it in shown.json but the trace's command line gets no 'held', so the reader loses it once the action is accepted
findings.outcome: open: a check that printed a held note leaves no trace row

findings.title: The run-file contract in state-files.md omits owner-notes/ (N<k>.md, shown.json) and calls the gate line host-only, though delegation also writes it

rejected.title: skill-calls.jsonl append blocks on a FIFO and skips the regular-file check that the trace writer adds (same defect fixed for the trace in 49a86d88)
`workspace start` is traced as verb `workspace`, which hides whether it ran init or next; undocumented

The product trace reader (`shiploop trace` digest, --json counts, trace.html) now shows every failed `complete --check-only` in a saved run as a refusal, which contradicts the firm 2026-10-25 finding and its committed evidence
No test checks that a torn final line is skipped and the next line still reads
The rule that a trace write never fails a command is only tested for the final append, not the code that builds the row

critic.title: A command that dies on an uncaught exception or Ctrl-C is traced as exit 2 with no message, so every reader counts it as a ShipLoop refusal
The generated context-index.md still lists RUN/chains/ (retired in ad30aa1c) and describes trace.jsonl and skill-calls.jsonl incompletely
The run-file catalog (state-files.md) leaves out timeline.json and callback-attempts, and its results/ row cites the removed planning_context.collect
